caption: The drawing shows four detailed illustrations of gold jewelry objects arranged against a plain light beige background. At the top center, there is a gold bracelet or bangle, decorated with an ornate design of small scrolls and dots around the outer surface. Below this, three more objects are arranged in a row. On the lower left, there is an open gold bangle with a delicate chain attached between the two ends. In the middle right, there is another gold bangle depicted in a closed circular form, also with a small chain visible near the clasp. At the bottom right, there is a detailed close-up of a gold clasp, showing the end pieces and the connecting mechanism, with shades of gold and brown indicating metallic texture and some shadowing for depth. At the bottom left, the name "John. H. Tercuzzi." is written in small, neat capital letters. The overall composition is symmetrical with clear spacing between each object, and the coloring uses gradients of yellow and brown to represent the sheen and form of the metallic surfaces.
title: Bracelet
